description: Get documentation for specific QuestDB functions, operators, or SQL keywords. This is much more efficient than loading all documentation.

category.description: The category of documentation to retrieve

items.description: List of specific docs items in the category. IMPORTANT: Category of these items must match the category parameter. Name of these items should exactly match the entry in the table of contents you get with get_questdb_toc.

name: get_questdb_documentation
